errors.evidence: The chart categories are countries ('държави'), not regions ('региони'). While the meaning is understandable from context, 'country' would be more precise.

errors.text_span: Общо работно време на седмица, включително извънреден труд (средно)
errors.evidence: The generated description misquotes the y-axis label. The actual label is 'Общо работни часове на седмица...' ('Total working hours per week...'), not 'Общо работно време на седмица...' ('Total working time per week...').

errors.text_span: Всички стойности са дадени с две decimalни цифри, освен във Франция, където стойността за жените е изписана като 37.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. While the value for women in France is an integer (37), many other values are not given with two decimal places. For example, the values for women in Bulgaria (41.3), Finland (34.9), and Slovakia (40.4) are given with one decimal place.

errors.text_span: всеки стълб е етикетиран със съответното име на държавата
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The groups of bars are labeled with the country name on the horizontal axis, not each individual bar.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по азбучен ред според държавите
errors.evidence: This information is redundant, as it was already stated earlier in the description that the countries on the horizontal axis are 'подредени по азбучен ред' (arranged in alphabetical order).

The prompt explicitly asks to 'include representative values from the shortest and longest bars'. The description only provides the values for the first country (Bulgaria) as an example and omits the highest (Czechia, Men: 45.64) and lowest (Finland, Women: 34.9) values in the chart.
